thread:
Maya: FYI Finnovate reached out — enterprise banking customer. They want a 30d POC to replace CompetitorY's generation endpoint. Requirements: drop-in compatibility for 3 endpoints, SAML SSO, KMS/HSM, regional residency (eu-west-1), and a hard pilot spend cap.

Dan: Are they asking for bitwise identical responses or just functional parity?

Maya: Functional parity. They'll run 1k "golden" prompts and want <=2% divergence across samples. They also expect streaming chunking to match current client behavior.

Rachel: Plan: deploy a lightweight proxy that maps routes and normalizes responses. We can add a response-normalizer plugin to fix date formats, nulls, and array ordering. Example mapping snippet we gave to another team:

```
# mapping pseudo
POST /v1/complete -> POST /v1/generate
header-mapping: Authorization -> X-RW-Api-Key
preserve: x-request-id, idempotency-key
post_process: normalize_tokens, coalesce_stream
```

Dan: We'll need their QPS and burst profile to mirror rate-limits. CompetitorY uses token-bucket per-tenant + per-route QPS. Can someone get numbers?

Maya: They've sent estimates in DM: ~250M tokens/month peak, ~300 concurrent streams peak. They want pilot <= $25k/month.

Sam: $25k for 250M tokens is tight unless we: 1) use a quantized variant, 2) enable prefix caching aggressively, or 3) offer a pilot discount/credit. I'll draft a 3-option pricing: parity(default), parity+HSM, and low-cost quantized.

Owen: Security notes: we support SAML + SCIM + KMS integrations. HSM-backed keys need ~2 weeks to provision. Audit log retention 90d by default; 1yr is enterprise add-on. For network we can do VPC peering or private link. Need their SOC2 contact and IP allowlist.

Rachel: Engineering timeline proposal: day 0-2: SSO/KMS onboarding and network; day 3-6: deploy proxy + normalizers; day 7-11: run golden prompt suite and iterate; day 12: go/no-go. Streaming chunk alignment and tokenizer diffs are the main technical risks.

Dan: For tokenizer deltas we'll run their prompts through our tokenizer in the shim and emit diffs. If diffs cause >2% failures we can switch model variant or apply token remapping heuristics.

Maya: I'll send over the questionnaire and golden prompts. Also asked for SLA: they want 99.5% uptime and p95 <300ms for happy-path.

Rachel: p95<300ms depends on model size. For large models we'll need provisioned capacity; for small quantized models it's achievable.

Sam: I'll prepare a pilot quote and call out tradeoffs.

Maya: Thanks — please reply with any blockers. :pray:

deploy-bot: deploy queued: staging/proxy-shim v2026.03.21 -> eu-west-1 (owner: Dan)
